_comment: Single source for which Cloud Run service serves which /api/v1 prefix. Read by both apps' Vite dev proxy and by infra/scripts/gen-firebase-json.mjs (Firebase Hosting rewrites), so local dev and production route identically and same-origin (no CORS). devPort: the service's local PORT (8081 = Firestore emulator, 8085 = Pub/Sub emulator are taken).
